SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attestations WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND created_at >= #{since} AND product = #{product}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO subscriptions (id, org_id, product, plan, status, config, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orgId}, 'attest', 'sandbox', 'active', '{}', #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM attestations WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND (reveal_txid = #{txid} OR commit_txid = #{txid} OR batch_id IN (SELECT batch_id FROM anchor_txs WHERE txid = #{txid})) LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM remit_payments p WHERE p.org_id = #{orgId} AND p.state = 'TRAVEL_RULE_PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remit_events e WHERE e.payment_id = p.id AND e.type = 'TRAVEL_RULE_RFI') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remit_events e2 WHERE e2.payment_id = p.id AND e2.type = 'TRAVEL_RULE_RECEIVED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM remit_payments WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND state = 'PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS' AND evidence_level = 'L1'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM remit_payments WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND state = 'EXCEPTION'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id) FROM remit_webhook_deliveries WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'exhausted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attestations WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status != 'confirmed'

SELECT p.id, p.state, p.created_at, (SELECT e.payload FROM remit_events e WHERE e.payment_id = p.id AND e.type = 'EXCEPTION' ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 1) AS payload FROM remit_payments p WHERE p.org_id = #{orgId} AND p.state = 'EXCEPTION' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.state, p.created_at FROM remit_payments p WHERE p.org_id = #{orgId} AND p.state = 'TRAVEL_RULE_PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remit_events e WHERE e.payment_id = p.id AND e.type = 'TRAVEL_RULE_RFI') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remit_events e2 WHERE e2.payment_id = p.id AND e2.type = 'TRAVEL_RULE_RECEIVED') ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.payment_id, d.last_error, d.created_at FROM remit_webhook_deliveries d WHERE d.org_id = #{orgId} AND d.status = 'exhausted' AND d.id = (SELECT d2.id FROM remit_webhook_deliveries d2 WHERE d2.org_id = d.org_id AND d2.payment_id = d.payment_id AND d2.status = 'exhausted' ORDER BY d2.created_at DESC, d2.id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM attestations WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND product = 'attest' GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attestations WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND product = 'attest' AND statement IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attestations WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND product = 'attest' AND issuer_trust = 'registered'

SELECT a.created_at AS c, x.confirmed_at AS f FROM attestations a JOIN anchor_txs x ON x.batch_id = a.batch_id WHERE a.org_id = #{orgId} AND a.product = 'attest' AND a.status = 'confirmed' AND x.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id, leaf_bytes, kind, status, created_at FROM attestations WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND product = 'attest' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CAST(trade_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS s FROM remit_payments WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND substr(created_at, 1, 10) = #{day}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CAST(trade_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS s FROM remit_payments WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM remit_payments WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY state
SELECT verdict FROM remit_manifests WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND date = #{date}
SELECT date, verdict FROM remit_manifests WHERE org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM remit_webhook_deliveries WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY status

SELECT p.created_at AS c, e.created_at AS f FROM remit_payments p JOIN remit_events e ON e.payment_id = p.id AND e.type = 'SETTLEMENT_RECONCILED' WHERE p.org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM remit_payments WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND created_at >= #{since} AND state IN ('RETURNED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXCEPTION')
